species.name: Coot
mustRead: white bill running up into a white forehead shield
sooty black rounded body
big lobed grey-green toes

species.name: Moorhen
mustRead: red bill with a yellow tip and red forehead shield
white streak along the flank
white undertail flashes with a cocked tail

species.name: Rail
mustRead: long slightly downcurved bill
narrow laterally flattened body for slipping through reeds
outsized long toes and a cocked short tail

species.name: Bittern
mustRead: dagger bill pointed straight up in the reed-mimic freeze pose
brown-and-buff streaked camouflage
thick hunched retractable neck

species.name: Oystercatcher
mustRead: long straight orange-red chisel bill
bold black-and-white blocked plumage
stout pink legs and a red eye ring

species.name: Godwit
mustRead: very long straight bill with a faint upward tilt and a pale base
long dark legs trailing behind in flight
cinnamon breast barred with dark chevrons

species.name: Avocet
mustRead: thin needle bill sweeping strongly upward
crisp black-and-white pied patterning
long blue-grey legs
species.note: The bill curves up, not down - the opposite of a curlew's.

species.name: Gannet
mustRead: long straight dagger bill with dark facial mask
buff-yellow wash over the head
white body with jet-black wingtips

species.name: Frigatebird
mustRead: deeply forked scissor tail
very long crooked M-shaped wings
hooked bill and, on males, an inflated scarlet throat pouch

species.name: Seabird
mustRead: long pointed wings folded over a streamlined body
stout hooked or dagger bill
webbed feet
species.note: generic name - drawn as a representative gull

species.name: Booby
mustRead: vividly coloured blue or red webbed feet
long tapered dagger bill running straight into the forehead
forward-set eyes flanking the bill giving a binocular stare

species.name: Tropicbird
mustRead: two extremely long ribbon tail streamers doubling the body length
black wedge stripe through the eye
stout red or yellow bill on a white pigeon-like body

species.name: Snow Petrel
mustRead: entirely pure white plumage
short black hooked bill with tube nostrils
long narrow pointed seabird wings

species.name: Chicken
mustRead: plump rounded body on scaly legs
small comb and wattles
short upswept fan of tail feathers

species.name: Rooster
mustRead: tall red comb and long wattles
arching sickle tail plumes
upright puffed chest with hackle cape

species.name: Kestrel
mustRead: hooked bill with dark moustache stripe
rufous back spotted with black
long barred tail and pointed falcon wings
species.note: Slim and small-headed - not the bulky broad-winged silhouette of a hawk or buzzard.

species.name: Starling
mustRead: glossy iridescent black plumage flecked with pale spots
sharp straight pointed bill
short square tail with triangular wings

species.name: Desert Owl
mustRead: flat facial disc with huge forward-facing eyes
pale sandy-buff plumage
feathered legs and hooked bill nearly hidden in face feathers
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a pale desert-dwelling owl (desert tawny owl type). Owls are taller than wide when perched.

species.name: Emu
mustRead: shaggy drooping hair-like double plumage
long bare blue-grey neck
no visible wings, long three-toed legs

species.name: Cassowary
mustRead: tall bony helmet casque on the head
vivid blue neck with red hanging wattles
glossy black hair-like plumage over a bulky body

species.name: Kiwi
mustRead: extremely long slender probing bill
round tailless body of shaggy hair-like feathers
stout short legs set far back
species.note: The bill can be a third of the body length and nostrils sit at its very tip; wings are invisible under the plumage.

species.name: Kakapo
mustRead: moss-green plumage mottled with black and yellow
owl-like whiskered facial disc
heavy squat flightless parrot body

species.name: Cockatoo
mustRead: raised fan crest of feathers on the crown
heavy dark hooked bill
two-forward two-back gripping toes
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a sulphur-crested cockatoo. The crest folds flat when relaxed and is the key identifying feature.

species.name: Harpy Eagle
mustRead: split double crest raised on the grey head
enormous grey talons thicker than a human finger
black chest band over a white belly
species.note: Wings are broad and short for forest flight, not long and soaring; the head is owl-like and pale.
